ALPACA_SECRET_KEY: Alpaca API secret key; pair with ALPACA_API_KEY. Never commit real values.
ALPACA_BASE_URL: Alpaca REST API base URL. Use https://paper-api.alpaca.markets/v2 for paper trading.
UNIVERSE_SOURCE: How the tradable universe is built (e.g. file reads UNIVERSE_FILE; other modes if configured).
UNIVERSE_FILE: Path to the universe list file when UNIVERSE_SOURCE=file (relative to project root unless absolute).
STARTING_CAPITAL: Starting portfolio value in dollars for backtests, training envs, and sizing context in paper/live.
LIVE_BUYING_POWER_MODE: Buying power used for live buy safety checks. 'non_marginable' = cash only (default, no margin). 'buying_power' = Alpaca intraday buying power including margin (up to 4x for eligible accounts).
LIVE_PPO_MODEL_PATH: Filesystem path to the PPO meta-learner checkpoint used when running live Alpaca trading.
TEST_WINDOW_PLACEMENT: Where to hold out TEST_WINDOW_DAYS for evaluation. 'recent' = newest days (classic walk-forward). 'oldest' = oldest days first; training uses newer market regimes. 'none' = no holdout; train and backtest on full history.
TEST_WINDOW_DAYS: Number of trading days held out when placement is recent or oldest (default 252). Ignored when placement is none.
ENV_IMF_RESTRICTIONS: Enable intraday margin (IMF) simulation in backtest, training, and live. When off, same-day sells after a buy are blocked (conservative). When on, uses IMF_MIN_INTRADAY_EQUITY and IMF_INTRADAY_MULTIPLIER.
IMF_MIN_INTRADAY_EQUITY: Minimum portfolio equity for full intraday multiplier (Alpaca 4x threshold is $2,000). Below this, simulated intraday buying power is 1x equity and same-day round trips are blocked.
IMF_INTRADAY_MULTIPLIER: Simulated intraday buying power multiplier when equity is at or above IMF_MIN_INTRADAY_EQUITY. Valid: 1, 2, or 4 (matches Alpaca margin tiers).
